# PgBuddy

> PgBuddy is a lightweight, type-safe PostgreSQL query helper for postgres.js v4. It provides Zod-first table schemas, relations and nested includes, joins, column mapping/codecs, typed filters, batching, pagination, prepared queries, streaming, and connection-level Valibot/Yup adapters — while keeping raw SQL and the postgres.js instance available.

## Start here

- [README](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/README.md): Installation, quick start, schema-first usage, and the main API overview.
- [Introduction](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/introduction.md): Product philosophy, validation model, and basic querying.
- [API reference](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/api-reference.md): PgBuddyClient, table builders, filters, writes, relations, batches, and adapters.
- [Advanced execution](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/advanced.md): Batching, prepared plans, transactions/retry, streaming, EXPLAIN, expressions, and SQL write helpers.
- [Examples index](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/examples.md): Pointers to runnable examples.

## Guides

- [CRUD operations](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/crud-operations.md): Create, read, update, delete, upserts, and conflict handling.
- [Select operations](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/select-operations.md): Projection, filtering, sorting, pagination, and computed fields.
- [Chainable API](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/chainable-api.md): How query state and chaining work.
- [Data transformation](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/data-transformation.md): Column mapping, codecs, and serialization.
- [Ecommerce kitchen sink](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/kitchen-sink.md): Walkthrough of the full API against a real ecommerce schema.
- [Roadmap](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/roadmap.md): Completed features and intentional out-of-scope items.

## Recipes

- [Paginated tables](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/recipes/paginated-tables.md): Offset pages, filtered totals, keyset/infinite pages, and app-level query helpers.
- [Soft deletes](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/recipes/soft-deletes.md): Explicit soft-delete scopes, partial unique indexes, and restore flows.
- [Tenant scoping and RLS](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/kiranojhanp/pgbuddy@dev/docs/recipes/tenant-scoping.md): App-level tenant filters, PostgreSQL RLS, and transaction-local settings.
